script.hook: The secret laws debt collectors pray you never look up.

points.title: THE STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS
points.line: Old debt legally expires. If you make even a $1 payment, the clock resets completely.

points.title: CEASE AND DESIST LETTERS
points.line: Send a written mail demanding they stop calling. By law, they must immediately stop all phone contact.

points.title: VALIDATION OF DEBT REQUEST
points.line: Force them to prove you owe the money. If they lack original paperwork, the debt is dismissed.

points.title: PAY FOR DELETE AGREEMENTS
points.line: Never pay without a written agreement stating they will erase the collection account from your credit report.

points.title: THE RECORDING LAW TRICK
points.line: State you are recording the call. Representatives will immediately stop using illegal, aggressive scare tactics.

script.closing: Knowledge is your best shield against predatory collectors.
